author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
A decade after Google Glass, smart glasses are making a comeback with new display technologies, expanded functionality, and hardware that tries its best to look like a normal pair of glasses. We test and review two smart glasses with very different approaches to wearable tech: Meta Ray-Ban Display and Even Realities G2. Here's what it's like to live and work with a high-tech heads-up display in 2026. 

Meta Ray-Ban Display: https://www.meta.com/ai-glasses/meta-ray-ban-display/
Even Realities G2: https://www.evenrealities.com/smart-glasses
Disclosure: The product was sent to us by the manufacturer for purposes of review and is not sponsored. 

Shot by Josh Self and edited by Norman Chan
Music by Jinglepunks
